data.name: Rule.SF-001
data.value: Sequence Flow source and target must be a FlowNode (Event, Activity, or Gateway).

data.name: Rule.SF-002
data.value: Source must not be an End Event.

data.name: Rule.SF-003
data.value: Target must not be a Start Event.

data.name: Rule.SF-004
data.value: Target must not be a Boundary Event.

data.name: Rule.SF-005
data.value: Source/target must not be an Event Sub-Process — it has no external Sequence Flow.

data.name: Rule.SF-006
data.value: Sequence Flow must not cross a Pool/Participant boundary (poolId mismatch).

data.name: Rule.SF-007
data.value: Sequence Flow must not cross a Sub-Process containment boundary (containerId mismatch).

data.name: Rule.SF-008
data.value: Source must not be a Compensation Boundary Event (use an Association to the handler instead).

data.name: Rule.SF-009
data.value: Source/target must not be a compensation Activity (isForCompensation=true) reached via normal flow.

data.name: Rule.SF-011
data.value: Event-Based Gateway outgoing target must be a catching Message/Timer/Signal/Conditional event or a Receive Task.

data.name: Rule.SF-012
data.value: Event-Based Gateway outgoing Sequence Flow must not carry a condition expression.

data.name: Rule.SF-013
data.value: Parallel Gateway outgoing Sequence Flow must not carry a condition.

data.name: Rule.SF-014
data.value: isDefault may only be set on a flow sourced from an Activity, or an Exclusive/Inclusive/Complex Gateway.

data.name: Rule.SF-016
data.value: Conditional Sequence Flow must not be sourced from a Parallel or Event-Based Gateway.

data.name: Rule.SF-017
data.value: Source must not be a Link Intermediate Throw Event — it continues at its paired Link catch, not by Sequence Flow.

data.name: Rule.SF-018
data.value: Target must not be a Link Intermediate Catch Event — it is reached from its paired Link throw, not by Sequence Flow.

data.name: Rule.MF-001
data.value: Source and target must be InteractionNodes: Participant/Pool, Activity, or Event.

data.name: Rule.MF-002
data.value: Source and target must be in different Participants/Pools.

data.name: Rule.MF-003
data.value: Gateways are never Message Flow endpoints.

data.name: Rule.MF-004
data.value: Lanes, Data Objects, Groups, and Text Annotations are never Message Flow endpoints.

data.name: Rule.MF-006
data.value: Target must not be an End Event.

data.name: Rule.MF-007
data.value: Source Event must be message-throwing (Message Intermediate Throw, Message End, or Multiple with a message result).

data.name: Rule.MF-008
data.value: Target Event must be message-catching (Message Start, Message Intermediate Catch, Message Boundary, or Multiple/Parallel Multiple with a message trigger).

data.name: Rule.DA-002
data.value: Group cannot be a connector endpoint (visual grouping only).

data.name: Rule.DA-002b
data.value: Group cannot be a connector endpoint (visual grouping only).

data.name: Rule.DA-003
data.value: Text Annotation connects only via (undirected) Association, never Data Association.

data.name: Rule.DA-004
data.value: Data Object/Data Store connect only via Data Association, never a plain Association.

data.name: Rule.DA-005
data.value: Data Input Association direction is Data Object/Store/Property to an Activity or Throwing Event input.

data.name: Rule.DA-006
data.value: Data Output Association direction is an Activity or Catching Event output to a Data Object/Store/Property.
